cli.vault_help.vault: Let this machine's agent read credentials teammates shared in Radient Vault (Radient Team)
cli.vault_help.connect: Create this agent's key, show its fingerprint and open the approval page
cli.vault_help.no_open: Print the approval link instead of opening a browser
cli.vault_help.timeout: How long to wait for your approval, in seconds (default 600)
cli.vault_help.status: Show whether agent access is available, this agent's key fingerprint and its approval
cli.vault_help.disconnect: Delete this machine's agent keys (revoke their access separately in the console)
